series.name: Ask Away Live Q&A
series.blurb: Livestreams where you bring the questions and Brandon answers them on the spot.

series.name: Overview of the Bible
series.blurb: What the Bible is, what the Gospel is, and how the whole story fits together.

series.name: Apologetics
series.blurb: The big objections, taken seriously and answered from Scripture.

series.name: Christian Doctrine
series.blurb: What Christians believe about God, Jesus, the church and ourselves, and why it matters.

series.name: Christian Living
series.blurb: Prayer, church, Bible reading, sharing your faith: following Jesus on an ordinary Tuesday.

series.name: Sin Series
series.blurb: What sin is, and straight answers to the "is it a sin?" questions people actually ask.

series.name: World View
series.blurb: How the Christian faith compares with the beliefs around us.

series.name: Armor of God
series.blurb: A walk through Ephesians 6 and the spiritual battle every believer is in.

series.name: Guest Conversations
series.blurb: Friends of the show on calling, mission and living out the faith.
